mentl/df529b1:
Effect op bindings (yield, result, report, fresh, etc.) now use __ev_op_ prefixed names throughout: dummy declarations, evidence install/restore, and cross-function calls. This cleanly separates user locals (source, env, n) from evidence globals -- the emitter filters __ev_op_*, __hs_*, __save_*, __ev_result from function locals. No ambiguity: unprefixed = local, prefixed = global.

Root cause: LLet(yield, closure) for evidence install was indistinguishable from a regular local binding. The emitter declared yield as a local, shadowing the global. Other functions calling yield through the global saw the old dummy, not the installed closure. 8/8 crucibles pass.

Automation, noodles-shaped (DECISIONS D5): every scene carries motion
lanes per track — a patch param mapped to 16 steps, the same grid as
every other lane in the app. Arm the new ● in the Sound sheet, play,
and perform: your finger on the XY pad (and any knob you touch) gets
sampled into the playing scene's lanes each 16th and loops from then
on. Only touched params are captured, so untouched knobs stay live.
Wobble builds are the proof case: wob color, ride amount and motion up
across the bar, and the rise replays every pass.

Playback schedules the morph ramps at the tick's transport time, so
automation lands on the heard beat instead of leading it by the
lookAhead; color-param changes apply at callback time (their plain-
property knobs can't be scheduled — noted, textural, acceptable).
Lanes live in the scene, so undo, cloning, project files, and the
offline render all carry them for free; a scene without lanes restores
the base patch exactly once. Recording works in both transport modes
via a recorder hook on the live voice state — offline renders have no
recorder and always play the lanes. Clear-motion lives in the Sound
sheet; closing any sheet disarms.

Smoke arms the bass, rides the pad through real setPatch calls during
playback, and asserts a scene grew an x lane with actual variety.
